estimate.prompt: About how many seconds did you wait after sending your request?
estimate.hint: Your best guess is fine. You can use decimals.

tlx.source: NASA Task Load Index (Hart and Staveland, 1988), raw (unweighted) scoring
tlx.intro: Think about the request you just sent and the wait that followed. For each item, click the box that best matches your experience.

items.label: Mental demand
items.question: How mentally demanding was the task?

items.label: Physical demand
items.question: How physically demanding was the task?

items.label: Temporal demand
items.question: How hurried or rushed was the pace of the task?

items.label: Performance
items.question: How successful were you in accomplishing what you were asked to do?

items.label: Effort
items.question: How hard did you have to work to accomplish your level of performance?

items.label: Frustration
items.question: How insecure, discouraged, irritated, stressed, and annoyed were you?

sus.intro: In these statements, "the system" means the assistant you just used. Choose one answer for each statement.
items: I think that I would like to use this system frequently.
I found the system unnecessarily complex.
I thought the system was easy to use.
I think that I would need the support of a technical person to be able to use this system.
I found the various functions in this system were well integrated.
I thought there was too much inconsistency in this system.
I would imagine that most people would learn to use this system very quickly.
I found the system very cumbersome to use.
I felt very confident using the system.
I needed to learn a lot of things before I could get going with this system.
